```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggsci)
library(gt)
library(htmltools)

dir.create("v2.0", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ── Unified palette ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Consistent colors for Balanced / Imbalanced across ALL figures
pal_balance <- c("Balanced" = "#4DBBD5", "Imbalanced" = "#E64B35")
# Consistent fill for estimator facets
pal_est <- scale_fill_npg()

# Publication-ready theme
theme_pub <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 9),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
theme_set(theme_pub)

# ── Read simulation results ─────────────────────────────────────────
results_dir <- if (dir.exists("v2.0") && length(dir("v2.0", pattern = "\\.csv$")) > 0) {
  "v2.0"
} else if (dir.exists(".") && length(dir(".", pattern = "\\.csv$")) > 0) {
  "."
} else {
  ".."
}

csv_files <- dir(results_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
csv_files <- csv_files[!grepl("^covariates", basename(csv_files))]

cat("Reading", length(csv_files), "CSV files from", results_dir, "\n")

df_list <- map(csv_files, ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(file = basename(.x)))
df <- bind_rows(df_list)

# Extract scenario parameters from filenames
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Balance = ifelse(grepl("^Imbal_", file), "Imbalanced", "Balanced"),
    xdiff = parse_number(str_extract(file, "xd[0-9.]+")),
    N = parse_number(str_extract(file, "N[0-9]+")),
    dims = parse_number(str_extract(file, "dim[0-9]+")),
  )

cat("Loaded", nrow(df), "rows,", length(unique(df$N)), "N values,",
    length(unique(df$xdiff)), "xdiff values\n")

# ── Identify which estimators are present ───────────────────────────
# The CSVs have columns like meanBeta1, meanBeta2, meanBetaMix (PPMx-common),
# meanBetaDPM, meanBetaKmeans, meanBetaStandard, etc.
# Detect all meanBeta* columns to find estimators.
est_cols <- grep("^meanBeta", names(df), value = TRUE)
est_names <- gsub("^meanBeta", "", est_cols)
cat("Estimator columns found:", paste(est_names, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Build a mapping: estimator label -> column name(s) for beta1 and beta2
# Some estimators have meanBeta1/meanBeta2, others have meanBetaMix1/Mix2, etc.
# We need to pivot carefully.
# Strategy: identify the estimator suffixes, then gather beta1 and beta2 per estimator.

# Get unique estimator suffixes (e.g. "Mix", "DPM", "Kmeans", "Standard")
# by looking at meanBeta<suffix>1 and meanBeta<suffix>2 patterns
beta1_cols <- grep("^meanBeta.*1$", names(df), value = TRUE)
beta2_cols <- grep("^meanBeta.*2$", names(df), value = TRUE)

# Extract the estimator label from each column
b1_labels <- gsub("^meanBeta|1$", "", beta1_cols)
b2_labels <- gsub("^meanBeta|2$", "", beta2_cols)

# Pair them up (should match by position)
est_map <- tibble(
  label = ifelse(b1_labels == "", "common", b1_labels),
  col1 = beta1_cols,
  col2 = beta2_cols
)

cat("Estimators:", paste(est_map$label, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ── Pivot to long: one row per (replicate, estimator, coef) ────────
long_est <- df %>%
  select(file, N, dims, xdiff, Balance, any_of(unlist(est_map[, c("col1", "col2")]))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(unlist(est_map[, c("col1", "col2")])),
    names_to = "col_name",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    coef = ifelse(grepl("1$", col_name), "β₁ (truth = +1)", "β₂ (truth = −1)"),
    truth = ifelse(grepl("1$", col_name), 1, -1)
  ) %>%
  # Map column name back to estimator label
  left_join(
    est_map %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(col1, col2), names_to = "which_col", values_to = "col_name") %>% select(label, col_name),
    by = "col_name"
  ) %>%
  rename(Estimator = label) %>%
  mutate(Estimator = recode(Estimator,
    "Mix" = "PPMx-common",
    "DPM" = "DPM",
    "Kmeans" = "K-means",
    "Standard" = "Standard PPMx"
  ))

# ── Detect clustering metric columns ────────────────────────────────
ari_cols <- grep("^salso.*ARI_Mix$|^ariMix$", names(df), value = TRUE)
binder_cols <- grep("^salso.*Binder.*Mix$|^binderMix$", names(df), value = TRUE)
nc_cols <- grep("^nc", names(df), value = TRUE)
cat("ARI cols:", paste(ari_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Binder cols:", paste(binder_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("NC cols:", paste(nc_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ── Detect predictive log-lik columns ───────────────────────────────
llik_cols <- grep("^llik", names(df), value = TRUE)
cat("Log-lik cols:", paste(llik_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ── Filter to balanced scenario grid ────────────────────────────────
scen <- df %>% filter(!is.na(N), !is.na(dims), !is.na(xdiff))
if (nrow(scen) == 0) stop("No parseable scenarios in ", results_dir)
useN <- if (1000 %in% scen$N) 1000 else max(scen$N)
useDims <- if (5 %in% scen$dims) 5 else max(scen$dims)
useX <- sort(unique(scen$xdiff[scen$N == useN & scen$dims == useDims]))
cat("Grid: N =", useN, ", dims =", useDims, ", xdiff =", paste(useX, collapse = ","), "\n")

df_f <- df %>% filter(N == useN, dims == useDims, xdiff %in% useX)
long_f <- long_est %>% filter(N == useN, dims == useDims, xdiff %in% useX)
```

## Figure 1: Clustering Quality (ARI & Binder Loss)

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
#| echo: false

# Build clustering long-form from the widest metric columns available
# ARI: we want salsoBinderARI_Mix (or similar) — the Mix (PPMx) estimate
ari_col <- grep("^salsoBinderARI_Mix$|^ariMix$", names(df_f), value = TRUE)[1]
vi_col  <- grep("^salsoVIARI_Mix$|^viMix$", names(df_f), value = TRUE)[1]

cluster_long <- df_f %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[ari_col]]) | !is.na(.data[[vi_col]])) %>%
  transmute(
    file, xdiff, Balance,
    `Binder ARI` = .data[[ari_col]],
    `VI ARI`     = .data[[vi_col]]
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Binder ARI`, `VI ARI`), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "ARI") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ARI))

p_ari <- cluster_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(xdiff), y = ARI, fill = Balance)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_balance) +
  labs(
    x = "xdiff (covariate separation)",
    y = "Adjusted Rand Index",
    title = "Clustering Recovery by Covariate Separation",
    subtitle = "SALSO point estimates vs truth. Median indicated.",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_ari)
ggsave("v2.0/fig1_ari.png", plot = p_ari, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## Figure 2: Common Effect Estimates (β₁, β₂)

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 7
#| echo: false

p_coef <- long_f %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(xdiff), y = estimate, fill = Balance)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.55, linewidth = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black") +
  geom_hline(data = tibble(truth_val = c(1, -1), coef = c("β₁ (truth = +1)", "β₂ (truth = −1)")),
             aes(yintercept = truth_val), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Estimator), cols = vars(coef), scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_balance) +
  labs(
    x = "xdiff (covariate separation)",
    y = "Posterior Mean Estimate",
    title = "Common Effect Recovery Across Estimators",
    subtitle = "Dashed lines = true values (β₁ = +1, β₂ = −1). Median indicated.",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_coef)
ggsave("v2.0/fig2_coefficients.png", plot = p_coef, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Figure 3: Predictive Log Density

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false

if (length(llik_cols) > 0) {
  llik_long <- df_f %>%
    select(file, xdiff, Balance, all_of(llik_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(llik_cols), names_to = "model", values_to = "loglik") %>%
    filter(!is.na(loglik)) %>%
    mutate(model = recode(model,
      "llikMix"   = "PPMx-common",
      "llikDPM"   = "DPM",
      "llikKmeans" = "K-means",
      "llikStandard" = "Standard PPMx"
    ))

  p_llik <- llik_long %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(xdiff), y = loglik, fill = Balance)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.55, linewidth = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~ model, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal_balance) +
    labs(
      x = "xdiff (covariate separation)",
      y = "Posterior Predictive Log Density",
      title = "Predictive Fit by Covariate Separation",
      subtitle = "Higher (less negative) is better. Median indicated.",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  print(p_llik)
  ggsave("v2.0/fig3_loglik.png", plot = p_llik, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)
} else {
  cat("No log-likelihood columns found in CSVs. Skipping Figure 3.\n")
}
```

## Summary Table

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Summarise key metrics across scenarios
summary_tbl <- df_f %>%
  group_by(xdiff, Balance) %>%
  reframe(
    n = n(),
    mean_beta1 = mean(meanBeta1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_beta2 = mean(meanBeta2, na.rm = TRUE),
    bias_beta1 = mean(meanBeta1 - 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    bias_beta2 = mean(meanBeta2 - (-1), na.rm = TRUE),
    rmse_beta1 = sqrt(mean((meanBeta1 - 1)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    rmse_beta2 = sqrt(mean((meanBeta2 - (-1))^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

summary_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = paste0("Scenario Summary (N=", useN, ", dims=", useDims, ")")) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 3) %>%
  opt_interactive(use_compact_mode = TRUE)
```

## Reproducibility

- **Julia 1.11.7** with `ProductPartitionModels.jl` (v2.0 branch)
- **R** with `tidyverse`, `patchwork`, `ggsci`, `gt`, `quarto`
- Results in `simulations/results/v2.0/`
- To regenerate: `julia --project=. sim.jl <params>` for each scenario

```bash
cd ~/software/ProductPartitionModels.jl/simulations
quarto render results/vizFull.qmd --to revealjs --output-dir results/v2.0/presentation
```
